statements.text: You know, I've heard folks mention anecdotally that now with artificial intelligence, people are trying to impersonate, you know, a loved one by virtue of maybe their voice or their mannerisms, what have you. And using some of that information that may have been stolen. Have you seen that? And could you elaborate on that for us?
statements.venue: House Oversight Committee hearing on digital identity verification and fraud

statements.text: I'm fascinated by the utility [AI] could offer in this space. I welcome any closing thoughts from you on how best AI could continue to strengthen our mission to eliminate waste, fraud and abuse?
statements.venue: House Oversight Subcommittee on Government Operations hearing on curbing federal fraud

statements.text: First and foremost, I'm inspired by what I'm seeing across the district, as it relates to people calling for referendums and an opportunity to have county-wide say in projects of this scale.
statements.venue: The Citizen interview on data centers

statements.text: We've got tons of business that flock to our counties because they want to be here. I think data centers offer an opportunity for rural, impoverished counties that may benefit from some of the tax advantages that will come to it, but I'm not sure that our counties — I guess I would dispute the notion that our county is in desperate need of economic growth and development, because so many businesses want to come here on their own.
statements.venue: The Citizen interview on data centers
